name: Sharltrue Schwartz
original_name: シャルトリュー・ シュワルツェ
source:
A prince of a country in the other world that is filled with fighting.
He hates conflict however and is a kind person who loves nature. However his mother doesn't approve.
The protagonist saves him from drowning and they become acquaintances afterwords.
He has a weirdly stilted way of talking.
